children: Modine announced a September 28 record date for the SpinCo distribution and disclosed adjustments that will result in Gentherm issuing ~2,902,466 additional shares and a reduced cash distribution to Modine.
Modine set September 28, 2026 as the record date; SpinCo distribution expected October 1, 2026, with the Merger closing the same day.
Exchange-ratio adjustment expected to increase issuance by ~2,902,466 Gentherm shares to preserve tax-free treatment while keeping economic allocation.
To offset extra shares, SpinCo’s cash distribution to Modine reduced from $210M to $159M prior to the Merger.
Gentherm declared a conditional special cash dividend of ~$58,350,533 (about $1.90/share) payable Oct 7, 2026, if the Merger closes.
Post-closing ownership expected ~56.4% Gentherm shareholders and ~43.6% former SpinCo holders based on estimated fully diluted shares.
